result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position: Vendor defends and indemnifies Customer and its Affiliates against third-party IP, legal-compliance, Vendor-caused data-breach, and gross-negligence/wilful-misconduct claims; Customer's indemnity is confined to Customer content and legal violations; and notice, defence control, cooperation, settlement protections, and IP remedies are included. The additions are appropriately limited and preserve the existing provisions. Drafting is generally professional, but the new indemnity and remedies are unnumbered, leaving Section 9.3's reference to Section 20.5 facially unresolved. The notice procedure also lacks the customary qualification that late notice relieves the indemnifying party only to the extent materially prejudiced.
